notes: εἰ καί is split under rule 65 rather than treated as one concessive unit; καί is left unrepresented because the ASV writes no word for it.
Both finite δώσει units carry the supplied *and* under rule 88, leaving each participle a bare verb; giving the *and* to the participle it follows was rejected as the single contrary corpus reading.
The modal *will* rides with the future δώσει rather than the adjacent participle, the participle carrying no future of its own (rule 9).
Variant v005 leaves φίλον αὐτοῦ as in the base projection, which the ASV's *his friend* matches; v006 is selected base and needs no further decision.
